thread:
Alana: Quick kickoff — AuroraChip alpha silicon validation shakeout next Tue. NDA signed yesterday. We need: bench harness, telemetry contract, runtime image access, and an embargo window for a joint announcement. Owners: Michael (bench), Sophie (runtime), Priya (security/deploy). Can folks confirm availability?
Michael: I can adapt redbench for this. Need a kernel/driver matrix and whether Aurora will provide quantized weights or we should quantize onsite. Target perf ask: are we aiming for tokens/sec @ seq512 with batch=8?
Sophie: For runtime we need the hardware image + kernel builds (kernels v2.1+), and pinned drivers (CUDA/ROCm). Also SSH access to a node with sudo to install our runtime container. Is Aurora comfortable with that?
Priya: For Marketplace/private packaging I need Aurora's SLA summary and compliance checklist. For telemetry: hashed request_id, p50/p95 latency, GPU temperature and power. Telemetry should POST to https://telemetry.redwood.internal/ingest. Example tags: `{"partner":"aurora","env":"alpha","run_id":"<uuid>"}` — strip PII.
devops-bot: Note: please open ENG-5723 for bench artifacts and SEC-2211 for telemetry review.
Michael: Example run command I'll use: `redbench run --model rdx-13b --batch 8 --seq 512 --profile=telemetry.json` — outputs perf CSV and flamegraphs. We'll upload artifacts to s3://redwood-partner-alpha/aurora/bench-2026-04-xx. I'll create ENG-5723 and link the artifacts.
Alana: Aurora requested a 48h embargo after final sign-off and a 30-min joint dry-run demo before the public announcement. Who can take the demo? Also need a brief press embargo calendar.
Sophie: I can lead the dry run Wed 10am PT. Will validate end-to-end and demo fallback behavior if kernel mismatch. :thumbsup:
Michael: I'll prepare a 3-slide perf caveats deck (quantized KV cache behavior, memory headroom, observed p95 tail causes) and link to the run notebook. Confluence doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PARTNERS/Aurora-alpha-shakeout
Priya: Raising SEC-2211 for telemetry ingestion & KMS policy review. Make sure we use customer-managed keys for artifacts.
Alana: Action checklist: Michael -> bench harness + ENG-5723; Sophie -> runtime image + demo Wed 10am PT; Priya -> SEC-2211 & KMS policy; Alana -> finalize embargo window and circulate schedule to Aurora by EOD. React with :white_check_mark: when you complete your item. :eyes:
Sophie: :white_check_mark:
Michael: :white_check_mark:
Priya: :white_check_mark:
